role: C04 small Material individual contextual source review
decision: Do not transplant the later MDC checkbox selected-contrast change into the owned Material 16 theme model. The exported legacy theme uses the background palette for its mark; the exported companion emits historical contrast-tone tokens and passes them into peer overrides. The peer token calculation and custom-palette rendering remain separate coexistence and visual obligations.

review_context.upstream_patch_summary: MDC M2 checkbox removes internal contrast-tone branch; selected checkmark derives palette default-contrast.
review_context.installed_peer_source_observation: Installed peer M2 checkbox token file now maps selected checkmark to system on-secondary; the patch-era default-contrast expression is not in this current file.
review_context.owned_reachability: Facade exports both checkbox themes; all-component includes the companion. Companion feeds owned token values into MDC theme and public checkbox overrides; selected checkmark is computed by owned _contrast-tone from the selected color. Tagged reference uses that calculation. The patch instead replaces an internal contrast branch with selected-palette default contrast. Custom contrast palettes and public peer override interactions remain unresolved; the legacy mark alone does not settle the companion boundary.
